worldcombat.skill.bind.summary: A line of long body or vine lashes out and ties the target to you. Sprint away and it drags you back; every squeeze cinches tighter, and both the tethered target and the user pulling the rope are slowed. The target can still move and fight, but it cannot leave the rope - unless it tears it apart in one step, a solid wall cuts the line, the rope runs out, or the binding on either end is cleansed. Pick any target, or just aim a direction and lash empty air; only the first enemy actually caught is tied.
worldcombat.skill.bind.use.0: Tether a fleeing target and drag it along beside you
worldcombat.skill.bind.use.1: Suppress a stubborn target with ever-tightening damage
worldcombat.skill.bind.use.2: Pull a target out of cover or out of the water
worldcombat.skill.bind.description.0: Lashes out to tie one target within %2$s blocks with a %3$s block grip radius, dealing about %1$s contact damage as it catches.
worldcombat.skill.bind.description.1: The rope is %1$s blocks long; a target past it gets pulled back (up to %2$s blocks at a time). While the rope is taut it cinches every %4$s, raising the power multiplier by %3$s each squeeze and drawing the rope shorter.
worldcombat.skill.bind.description.2: The rope lasts up to %1$s, and snaps if either end is displaced more than %2$s blocks apart; a solid wall between the two ends, the binding on either end being cleansed, or either one going down also frees it.
worldcombat.skill.bind.description.aim: Free aim: pick an any-relation entity, or just give a direction or world point and lash empty air; only the first hostile living target actually caught is tied, while hitting a wall or empty air is just a miss.
worldcombat.skill.bind.choke.on: Choke form: a shorter rope that cinches faster, drags harder, lasts longer and hits harder per squeeze, at the cost of a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.bind.choke.off: Tow form: a longer rope with a gentler cinch, lighter drag and shorter duration at base per-squeeze power, leading the target around leniently.
worldcombat.skill.bind.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.bind.growth.0: At level %1$s, Bind power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bind.growth.1: At level %1$s, Bind power rises to %2$s, the rope to %3$s blocks and the cinch to %4$s.
On: a shorter rope that cinches faster, drags harder, lasts longer and hits harder per squeeze, but with a longer cooldown, holding the target right at your feet. Off (tow form): a longer, gentler rope with lighter drag and shorter duration at base per-squeeze power that leads the target around leniently.
worldcombat.skill.bind.preference.ai.max: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of lashing out. The rope cannot reach further, so larger values mostly invite whiffs while chasing.
worldcombat.skill.bind.preference.ai.pre: On: targets moving fast or fleeing come first - rope them before they get away. Off: it only orders by threat and distance.
worldcombat.skill.bind.preference.ai.min: Below this health fraction it stops reaching out to tether (unless the target is nearly down): the rope slows the user too, so sharing a slow at low health is dangerous. Higher values protect the user more and tether weakened targets less.
worldcombat.skill.bind.description.slow: The tethered target's movement speed is reduced by 25%, and the user pulling the rope is slowed by 22% as well; both return to normal once the rope is gone.
